name: Compare the brands of many websites in one table (CSV) with MiroMiro

parameters.content:
## Compare the brands of many websites
Put a list of websites in **Settings**, one per line. MiroMiro reads each brand and n8n puts them in one table: brand colors, fonts, logo, and how sure MiroMiro is.

Download the CSV from **Save as a spreadsheet** and open it in Excel or Google Sheets. Useful for competitor research and client pitches.

10 credits per website.

**Setup (1 minute)**
1. Get a free MiroMiro API key (300 credits a month, no card): https://miromiro.app/api/onboarding
2. Open any MiroMiro node > Credential > Create new, paste the key.
3. Change the website in **Settings**, then click **Execute workflow**.
